description: The train types a station board («Tipi di treno») and the widgets can hide: Frecce/AV, Intercity/notte, Regionali/suburbani, Italo, Bus, Internazionali. A row's group comes from what the sources already publish: a bus, the operator (Italo, an operator outside Italy), then the letters that open its category or line label. A train whose type no source tells has no group and is never hidden. The rule has the cases of contracts/shared-rules/v1/train-type-groups-v1.json.
